works.version: Bradley Hagood Smith, University of Tennessee Knoxville PhD (1998), repository original scan
scope: PDF1–74: PDF1–17 front matter; PDF18–21 Ch. 1; PDF22–39 Ch. 2 Nilsson, CSM, TRS and B(M1)/B(E2); PDF40–74 Ch. 3 apparatus, Microball PID and coincidence sorting.
PDF75–107 (printed pp.58–90): DCO methods, evaporation channels, 130Pr Table 4.2, and the lead-in to 128Pr.
PDF108–139 (printed pp.91–122): decay schemes, tables, and spectra constraining 130,128,131,129Pr assignments, including the four SD candidates.
PDF140–234: Tables 4.4–4.6, Ch. 5 TRS/CSM and band comparisons, Ch. 6 conclusions, bibliography and vita.
checks: Original PDF20 printed p.3 and Sec. 5.8.2 support 131Pr, not 130Pr, for the four candidate SD sequences.
Archived source location and actual printed p.=PDF−17 checked on numbered pages.
Printed p.115 explicitly allows possible 130Pr contamination for SD-2A. The author favors 131Pr using coincidences, without resolved linking transitions.
PDF99–105 Table 4.2 headings and separation of observed gamma and DCO versus assigned spin checked.

PDF33 / p.16, Table 2.1: CSM quasiparticle labelling conventions. PDF50 / p.33, Table 3.2: geometry pages list possible Ge angle positions. PDF51–53: Microball layout and particle identification context.

PDF193–196 / pp.176–179, Fig. 5.20: signature inversion concerns the odd-odd 128Pr and 130Pr pi h11/2 times nu h11/2 candidates. The thesis finds limited low-frequency softness in the 130Pr TRS and discusses additional mechanisms.
PDF220 / p.203: total alignment of about 13.5 hbar belongs to the CSM comparison for 130Pr band 7. The oblate assignment is inferred.
PDF222 / p.205: Q0=6.1(4) eb and beta2=0.35(3) for the 130Pr ED structure are cited to Ref. [42] (Kondev et al.). The thesis uses them as external comparison.
PDF234 carries printed p.217 (vita). Printed pages 1–217 follow PDF minus 17. Front matter precedes that offset.

Visually checked PDF222/p.205: 92%-enriched 94Mo replaced the contaminated 92Mo target, with 180 MeV 40Ca. PDF8 has a conflicting beam symbol. The chapter and final apparatus/data narrative settle the actual reaction; the 3p and p-alpha mass balances agree.
works.gap: Text encoding loses symbols and plots. Formula and figure-based claims require the specific original visual page. Complete scientific section coverage does not imply event-level reproduction, visual digitization or line-by-line extraction of all transitions.
works.lineage: One main charged-particle gated experiment and model interpretation across neighboring nuclei.
